title: Returns, Purchase Credits and Reward Reversals on Northgate Credit Cards
content:
Northgate rewards operations note on how returns and purchase credits act on the rewards of a Northgate Credit Cards account.

## Clause

Where the card's terms provide that returns reverse rewards, returns and purchase credits reduce the rewards of the statement they post on, in the same earning category, at the rate the card's reversal-rate basis names — the rate earned by the original purchase. When a category's credits on a statement exceed its purchases the net credit is booked as a reversal; the reversal never takes the card rewards balance below zero, and a reversal after the reward year's certificate was issued is booked in the current reward year.

## The clause by element

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Which statement | The statement the return or purchase credit posts on |
| Which category | The same earning category as the purchase |
| Rate | The rate earned by the original purchase |
| Credits exceed purchases in a category on a statement | The net credit is booked as a reversal for that statement and category |
| Floor | A reversal never takes the card rewards balance below zero |
| After the reward year's certificate was issued | The reversal is booked in the current reward year |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

**Case 1 — credits smaller than purchases.** On one statement a card shows $300.00 of travel purchases and a $100.00 travel credit. The credit reduces that statement's travel rewards: the category's net qualifying purchases are $200.00.

**Case 2 — credits larger than purchases.** On one statement a card shows $40.00 of restaurant purchases and $100.00 of restaurant credits. The net credit of $60.00 is booked as a reversal in restaurants. If the returned purchase originally earned a hypothetical 3%, the reversal is $60.00 at 3%, or $1.80.

**Case 3 — the floor.** The same reversal of $1.80 meets a card rewards balance of $1.00. The balance stops at $0.00; it does not become negative.

**Case 4 — after the certificate.** A purchase from a hypothetical reward year 2025 is returned on a statement of March 2026, after the 2025 certificate was issued. The reversal is booked in the current reward year, 2026, not in 2025.

**Case 5 — rate earned, not current rate.** A purchase that earned a hypothetical 4% is credited on a later statement on which the same category would earn a hypothetical 1%. The reversal is computed at 4%, the rate the original purchase earned.
